Commentary.Commentary: Back for the chase.
...THE CHASE...

Zimbabwe bowled well and used the new ball very effectively. Their bowlers toiled hard to pick 10 wickets. Richard Ngarava was the pick of the lot as he finished with four wickets while Trevor Gwandu and Wessly Madhevere ended with two each. Now, Zimbabwe need a good start. Their first aim will be to end the day without losing any wickets but Ireland will be pumped up to make early inroads. Chase coming up next.

So, Zimbabwe need 292 runs to win. That would take some effort as the pitch is assisting the bowlers here. Ireland will be happy with how they played. All of their batters got off to a start and made handy contributions. Andy Balbirnie was key to get things going for Ireland. They lost a couple of wickets in heaps, but Lorcan Tucker's fifty made sure they got a score close to 300.

TEA! A much better performance from Zimbabwe in this session and they believe they can clean up Ireland today itself. It wasn't the cast at the start of the session as Harry Tector and Andy Balbirnie looked solid for while but the spinners bowled it accurately to get rid of both of them in quick succession. Paul Stirling and Andy McBrine got off to a start but fell later. Adair, who played so well in the first innings edged one straight to first slip. His wicket was very crucial for Zimbabwe and they now have to just manage to get the wicket of Tucker. His wicket could be the pivotal point in this match. Can Zimbabwe get him straight after the break? Stay tuned to find out.

Commentary.Commentary: We're all set for the action to begin! The players make their way out to the middle.

Zimbabwe on the other hand, weren't at their best with the ball in the last session of Day 2, they'll be hoping to bowl a lot better, hit the right lines and lengths and try and get some early wickets to get on top in this game. An important first session awaits.

The game is quite nicely poised at the moment! Both the sides have let the advantage slip out of their hands. It was Zimbabwe in the first innings and then it was Ireland. The visitors now though are in a decent position and will hope their batters can continue the good work done so far. They'll be aiming to take their lead to over 300.
... DAY 3, SESSION 1 ...

In reply, Ireland have begun really well with the bat! Their openers got them off to a good start. Moor fell but Andy Balbirnie and Curtis Camoher have continued the good work. The lead is 76 and Ireland would be hoping for one big partnership. Zimbabwe on the other hand, will hope for quick wickets. Day 3 promises to be an exciting one. Do join us for it. Until then, goodbye and take care!

End of a very good day of cricket! Ireland in the end will be happy with their position. They could have been in a lot stronger position when they had Zimbabwe reeling for  200 for 9 but the last wicket stand added 50 plus and took them into the lead. A slender lead but a lead.
